cat > /workspace/tmp/test_storage.py <<'PY'
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import ordered as o

def check(n):
    if n is None:return 0,[]
    a,ak=check(n.left);b,bk=check(n.right)
    assert abs(a-b)<=1,(n.key,a,b)
    assert n.height==1+max(a,b)
    if ak:assert ak[-1]<n.key
    if bk:assert bk[0]>n.key
    return n.height,ak+[n.key]+bk

for seed in range(10):
    r=random.Random(seed);d={};root=None;saves=[]
    for i in range(10000):
        cmd=r.randrange(10)
        if cmd<4:
            k=r.randrange(4000);d[k]=k;root=o.put(root,k,k)
        elif cmd==4 and d:
            k=r.choice(list(d));del d[k];root=o.erase(root,k)
        elif cmd==5 and d:
            ks=sorted(d)[:r.randrange(1,33)];out=[];root,_=o.take_min(root,len(ks),out)
            assert out==ks
            for k in ks:del d[k]
        elif cmd==6 and d:
            ks=sorted(r.sample(sorted(d),min(len(d),r.randrange(1,33))))
            root=o.erase_many(root,ks)
            for k in ks:del d[k]
        elif cmd==7:
            saves.append((root,d.copy()));o.new_epoch()
        elif cmd==8 and saves:
            root,d=r.choice(saves);d=d.copy();o.new_epoch()
        elif cmd==9 and d:
            node,root=o.pop_max(root);assert node.key==max(d);del d[node.key]
        if i%100==0:
            _,ks=check(root);assert ks==sorted(d)
    for n,ds in saves:
        _,ks=check(n);assert ks==sorted(ds)
print('AVL invariants and snapshot tests passed')
PY
cd /workspace && python3 -B tmp/test_storage.py
